summary: DB/risk/config area S1 batch (22-21 Task 3, D-16 area-batch tier), presented together once the DB slice audit (src/utils/db.ts, src/riskManager.ts, src/config.ts, src/chainRegistry.ts, src/preflight.ts, src/utils/logger.ts, src/utils/notifier.ts at audit base 23a6461), its thresholds inventory and cards OD-10, OD-18, OD-25 and DB-01..06 were complete. Five S1 entries, each a way a risk limit can silently stop working or a held position can be lost from the records under a realistic condition: AUD-DB-002 (independent, EXPOSURE) the daily-loss breaker and the exposure cap compare numbers in different units: buy rows store amount_in as a native-unit decimal ("0.01") while sell and partial_sell rows store amount_out and gas_cost as wei integer strings, and the risk SQL subtracts one from the other with no conversion (src/utils/db.ts:425-459; src/bot.ts:1127-1145, :1451-1466, :773-786; src/exitEngine.ts:1073-1093; src/utils/receiptDecoder.ts:62, :83), so ordinary losing trades never count as a loss and one partial sell makes total exposure hugely negative; reproduced offline on a throwaway in-memory SQLite with the SQL text taken verbatim from the audit-base snapshot (25 trades each sold at a 50% loss, true loss 0.1325 ETH against a 0.1 ETH limit: SQL daily loss 0, breaker does not trip); card DB-01; AUD-DB-003 (independent, OVERSPEND) a position still held after a failed sell is marked trades.status = 'failed', and every risk query counts only status = 'pending' buys, so stuck positions drop out of the open-position limit, the exposure cap and the daily-loss total and the bot keeps buying past its limits (src/exitEngine.ts:1159-1166; src/utils/db.ts:420-438; src/riskManager.ts:48-63); card DB-01; AUD-DB-004 (RC-14, STRAND) a buy that lands has no database row until its whole submission returns (minutes on a private bundle); a first Ctrl+C runs the cleanup that closes the database and exits at once, and any crash in that window leaves a held token the bot does not know about; synchronous = NORMAL under WAL can also roll back the last commits on a power loss (src/bot.ts:1100-1145, :1431-1466, :2251-2349; src/utils/db.ts:20-22); card OD-18; AUD-DB-001 (RC-06, EXPOSURE) a non-numeric MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE, DAILY_LOSS_PCT, SNIPE_COOLDOWN_MS, MAX_POSITION_SIZE or per-chain max capital parses to NaN and every comparison against it is false, so that limit is off; recorded per parser site, with the fail-closed sites (MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS at src/preflight.ts:185-197, block-age tolerance at src/chainRegistry.ts:674-682) kept separate from the fail-open ones (src/riskManager.ts:26-36, :81-148; src/chainRegistry.ts:663-665); the same defaults are written out at four sites with three different parsers; card OD-25; AUD-DB-007 (section C SC-21, STRAND) the database path resolves against the current working directory (unset DB_PATH and the shipped DB_PATH=./data/bot.db alike) and db.ts creates the folder and an empty database when none is there, so starting the bot from another directory boots on a fresh database with the kill-switch off, no open positions resumed and empty dedup and loss history (src/utils/db.ts:9, :12-17, :171-190; .env.example:92); being closed in this phase by the planned rail 22-09 and re-audited in 22-29. Related but not S1 and not asked: AUD-DB-006 (RC-25, S2, no newer-schema guard) is also being closed by rail 22-09; AUD-DB-009 (S2, the Telegram bot token reaches the logs inside a failed request) and AUD-DB-010 (S2, the RPC URL including its API key reaches a Telegram alert through a preflight failure reason), both reproduced offline with fake values on loopback, are secret-handling items for Phase 24 (card TX-04). No S0, no rail, test-origin-db-row or non-public-secret item was found in the DB slice. The bot is OFF for all of v7.0, so none of these can cause a loss now. Nothing is changed in Phase 22 (NAC-13): each item is proven with a real-path test in Phase 23 and fixed in Phase 24 unless a rail closes it first. The operator was asked to acknowledge and say whether any item needs its own urgent decimal phase before Phase 24, or to stop the phase.

ruling_option_text: acknowledge-continue: Acknowledge and continue (default plan). The audit keeps going; all items wait for Phase 23 proof and Phase 24 fixes with the bot off.
ruling_note: Interpretation recorded as relayed by the orchestrator: the operator chose the acknowledge-continue option for all five S1 entries. No severity was changed, no decimal phase is inserted, and Phase 22 continues. Context, attributed to the execute-phase orchestrator and NOT to the operator (shown to the operator with the checkpoint): AUD-DB-002 is the most important item in this batch and should be first in line in Phase 23 and Phase 24, because it touches money math, where a real-path proof matters most; the orchestrator independently confirmed that the risk SQL at src/utils/db.ts:425-459 at the audit base subtracts amount_in from amount_out and the gas costs with no unit conversion. Card OD-25 (risk default values) must be decided treating today's daily-loss and exposure limits as NOT working, because changing their values does nothing until AUD-DB-002 is fixed; that caution is added to OD-25, attributed the same way. AUD-DB-009 (Telegram bot token to logs) and AUD-DB-010 (RPC URL including the API key sent to Telegram) were highlighted to the operator as secret-handling items for Phase 24. AUD-DB-007 (and the S2 AUD-DB-006) are being closed by rail 22-09, which 22-29 re-audits. As S1 capital findings, none of these can rest on a keep-current default; each blocks the live re-entry gate until it is fixed (or, for AUD-DB-007, until the rail is re-audited and the entry moves forward on evidence).
